    • Class io.milvus.bulkwriter.request.import_.CloudImportRequest extends BaseImportRequest implements Serializable

      serialVersionUID:
      6487348610099924813L

      • Serialized Fields

        • clusterId

          String clusterId

        • projectId

          String projectId
          For project database deployments: use projectId and regionId instead of clusterId.

        • regionId

          String regionId
          For project database deployments: use projectId and regionId instead of clusterId.

        • dbName

          String dbName
          For Free & Serverless deployments: specifying this parameter is not supported. For Dedicated deployments: this parameter can be specified; defaults to the "default" database.

        • collectionName

          String collectionName

        • partitionName

          String partitionName
          If the collection has partitionKey enabled: - The partitionName parameter cannot be specified for import. If the collection does not have partitionKey enabled: - You may specify partitionName for the import. - Defaults to the "default" partition if not specified.

        • objectUrls

          List<E> objectUrls
          Data import can be configured in multiple ways using `objectUrls`:

          1. Multi-path import (multiple folders or files): "objectUrls": [ ["s3://bucket-name/parquet-folder-1/1.parquet"], ["s3://bucket-name/parquet-folder-2/1.parquet"], ["s3://bucket-name/parquet-folder-3/"] ]

          2. Folder import: "objectUrls": [ ["s3://bucket-name/parquet-folder/"] ]

          3. Single file import: "objectUrls": [ ["s3://bucket-name/parquet-folder/1.parquet"] ]

        • objectUrl

          String objectUrl
          Deprecated. 
          Use `objectUrls` instead for more flexible multi-path configuration.

          Folder import: "objectUrl": "s3://bucket-name/parquet-folder/"

          File import: "objectUrl": "s3://bucket-name/parquet-folder/1.parquet"

        • accessKey

          String accessKey
          Specify `accessKey` and `secretKey`; for short-term credentials, also include `token`.

        • secretKey

          String secretKey
          Specify `accessKey` and `secretKey`; for short-term credentials, also include `token`.

        • token

          String token
          Specify `accessKey` and `secretKey`; for short-term credentials, also include `token`.
